say:2:1321425001:1.text: Don't forget this talisman. Your ancestor left this for you.
say:2:1321425001:1.source_cn: 喏，别忘了带走这个护身符！这可是先祖留给你们的遗物！

say:3:1321425002:1.text: Thank you. I will forever keep it safe.
say:3:1321425002:1.source_cn: 谢谢，我一定会好好保存的。

say:4:1321425003:1.text: Once we're back in town, Peter and I will change our last name to Kaminsky again. We'll work hard to regain everyone's recognition and bring honor back to our family name.
say:4:1321425003:1.source_cn: 等回到镇上，我会和彼得改回卡明斯基这个姓氏，靠自己的努...

say:5:1321425004:1.text: I'll spread the word about the undead so more people can learn of the deeds of these unsung heroes and stop viewing them merely as Hypogean minions...
say:5:1321425004:1.source_cn: 当然，我也会把活死人的事告诉大家，让更多人知道这些无名...

say:9:1321425006:1.text: Yes, I promise. Starting today, I won't touch a drop ever again.
say:9:1321425006:1.source_cn: 没问题，从今天开始，一滴也不会再碰。

say:10:1321425007:1.text: As descendants of the Kaminsky family, we must avoid a life of indulgence and uphold our forebears' valor.
say:10:1321425007:1.source_cn: 卡明斯基的后裔，当然要继承先祖的英勇，绝不会颓废度日！
